name: Sivarom Real Estate Public Company Limited
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand, Sivarom Real Estate Public Company Limited, along with its affiliated entities, is a property development firm active within the Thai market. The company undertakes the creation of a wide array of residential and commercial projects, encompassing individual houses, duplexes, townhouses, business premises, and apartment complexes. A key part of their operations also involves the acquisition of land for these developments. Additionally, Sivarom manufactures and distributes various types of prefabricated building systems. The corporation was established in 2017.
